description: Run coding, review the result with spirit, remediate confirmed findings, re-review with CodeRabbit, remediate confirmed findings, then document and release the changes.
name: coding spirit coderabbit and document changes

configJson.prompt: Review the current working tree and the immediately preceding spirit findings for {application}. Remediate confirmed correctness, security, type, lint, or stack-compliance issues from the review. Do not broaden scope beyond review findings. Run the project's required validation gates and leave the tree ready for document-changes.

Review the current working tree and the immediately preceding CodeRabbit findings for {application}. Remediate confirmed correctness, security, type, lint, or stack-compliance issues from the review. Do not broaden scope beyond review findings. Run the project's required validation gates and leave the tree ready for document-changes.
